text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #21421 (optimize batcher) is blocked by mac-integration failing flaky e2e. We need an eyeball + a rebase window before the deploy freeze at 17:00 UTC tomorrow. Any volunteers?
ken: I can look in ~30m. Do we have the failing test name?
maria: Thanks. It's the video-encoder smoke test. CI shows timeout on mac-local-run step. Logs: ```TimeoutError: video encoder init exceeded 120s
...stack...``` Might be env-specific.
sophie: @maria @ken I can rerun the mac matrix now — kicking off `ci-bot rerun pr/21421 mac-matrix`. If it flakes again we should rebase to main and try a clean run.
ci-bot: rerun queued by sophie — mac-matrix started (job id mac-9821). ETA ~15m.
ken: looking at the test, there was a recent change in the ffmpeg vendor path in main. Rebase might fix it. maria can you rebase and push?
maria: Rebased to main and force-pushed. New sha a1b2c3. Kicking rerun now: `ci-bot rerun pr/21421 mac-matrix --fresh-cache`.
ci-bot: mac-matrix (mac-9821) passed ✅. Integration step still failing on `/integration/encoder-smoke` though — logs show intermittent file permission error.
alex: Heads up — deploy freeze starts at 17:00 UTC tomorrow for infra maintenance. If we want to land before that, we need approvers to greenlight final merge by 13:00 UTC to allow rollback testing.
sophie: I can do final approve and smoke after 11:30 UTC. If tests are stable we can land by 12:30. :thumbsup:
maria: Awesome. Can @alex or @ken give final +1 for behavior change? It's a small vendor path fix.
ken: +1 assuming integration flake resolved — I'll monitor next run and add a review.
maria: Thanks all — marking for canary: `canary=true` on merge, and will add a rollback PR just in case. Will ping again at 11:00 UTC.
